reapack.name: reaper_ambix.ext
reapack.desc: ambiX (.ambix) file support for REAPER, plus a loudness normalize action

version.author: Matthias Kronlachner
version.changelog: - Distribute through ReaPack (raw per-platform binaries on GitHub releases) - New action: normalize selected item(s) to a target integrated loudness (LUFS), measured locally to ITU-R BS.1770-4. Ambisonic items are measured on the W channel alone; surround beds use the BS.1770-5 Annex 3 weighting up to 9.1.4 - Analysis runs behind a progress dialog and can be cancelled - Linux (x86_64 + aarch64) and Windows ARM64 builds - macOS builds are now universal (Apple Silicon + Intel)

metadata.description:

\b\fs36 reaper_ambix\b0\fs22\par \par REAPER extension adding read and write support for .ambix files following the ambiX (Ambisonics eXchangeable) specification. Output can be written uncompressed (CAF container) or with WavPack lossless compression; reading auto-detects the container.\par \par It also adds an action to the main action list:\par \par \b ambiX: Normalize selected item(s) to target loudness (LUFS)...\b0\par \par Measures the integrated loudness of each selected item to ITU-R BS.1770 and sets the take volume so it lands on the target you enter. Ambisonic items are measured on the W channel alone; surround beds use the BS.1770-5 Annex 3 channel weighting up to 9.1.4.\par \par Restart REAPER after installing or updating.\par }
